Calculation source

Question

How does an execution compare with the volume-weighted price of trades in the chosen window?

Method

VWAP = Σ(price × volume) / Σ(volume). The window includes its start and excludes its end. The cumulative series resets at that start.

Interpretation

Positive execution cost means worse execution for either side. Buy cost = (execution − VWAP) / VWAP × 10,000; sell cost reverses the sign.

Limitations

This synthetic tape is a calculation demonstration. The comparison excludes fees, impact and order size; it provides no evidence of trading profitability.
